name: BBC
note: Strong sourcing and clear distinction between reporting and analysis.

name: Reuters
note: Wire-service reporting with a strong corrections tradition.

name: AP
note: Broadly cited wire coverage and transparent standards.

name: Al Jazeera
note: Deep international reporting; framing can vary by region.

name: CNN
note: Strong breaking-news operation with a visible opinion layer.

name: The Guardian
note: Reliable reporting with an openly progressive editorial stance.

name: Fox News
note: News and opinion are clearly distinct in some sections and blended in others.

name: NY Post
note: Fast, vivid tabloid coverage; verify high-stakes claims.

name: RT
note: State-funded outlet; independent verification is especially important.

name: Wall Street Journal
note: Highly regarded business reporting with a conservative editorial page.
